entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling because I'd like to return an Urban Commuter Helmet I purchased last week.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's just a preference issue. The product itself seems fine, but the color isn't quite what I expected from the pictures online. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging; the box is still unopened.
I understand completely. So, just to confirm, there are no concerns with the fit or any of the safety features, it's purely the color of the helmet?
That's correct. Everything else seems to be high quality, as expected from VeloFit.

Not a problem at all. Let me just pull up your order information... Yes, I see it here. You received it just seven days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days for a return, so you are well within the window. I've gone ahead and approved that for you.

Excellent, thank you for the quick resolution. Now, since I do plan on ordering another helmet in a different color, I was wondering if you could offer a small discount code for my next purchase, just to make the process a bit smoother.

That's a fair question. Let me check your account status. Ah, I see you're a VIP member with us. In that case, I can absolutely add a 15% discount to your account for your next order. It will become active once we receive the returned item. How does that sound?
A 15% discount would be perfect. I appreciate you doing that for me, Charlie.
Of course! I've just sent the prepaid return label to the email address on file. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
